category_title: Students who engage in high social interaction but require frequent off-task redirection
scenario_title: Off-task social conversations during collaborative projects
minimal_context: The student is working in a mixed-age group of two to three peers on a collaborative project in a high school social studies classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please get into your groups of two or three and start working on your collaborative social studies project.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Hey guys! It's so great to be in a group with you. Did you see that new movie that came out this weekend?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's try to look at the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Yeah, we will in a second. I'm just easily distracted today. But seriously, the ending of that movie was crazy, right?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to work on the project.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm trying, but I just have a total lack of focuses right now. Anyway, what are you guys doing after school today?

task.content: Collaborative projects in a high school social studies classroom

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When student groups demonstrate high social interaction that is not academically focused
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Having social conversations that were not academically focused
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Lack of focuses or easily distracted

behavior_patterns.condition: Walking around and observing each group
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Maintaining frequent to constant positive communication; conversations were lighthearted and they showed a respect for one another
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Lack of focuses or easily distracted
